g.title: j2119225044
g.text: after extensive research, I've determined which beverage to recommend u try ^_^

g.title: j83189204
g.text: sweet and salty. best of both worlds! just the way u like it

g.title: j1726358858
g.text: You've really done your research. I'm flattered. I'll have to try one.

g.title: j2294717247
g.text: Is that so? I'd like to try it. We should go out and get some together.

g.title: j4166025355
g.text: Look, this whole manic pixie dream girl act is cute and all, but I don't need it in my life.

g.title: j2906278546
g.text: it's as dark and rich as ur beautiful soul

g.title: j1754911553
g.text: I doooubt we'll find a trendy cafe in Höllvania...

g.title: j2149320470
g.text: its flavor profile straddles earthy and spicy much like how u straddle past and future!

g.title: j3430719669
g.text: but let's plan for the future!

g.title: j953646876
g.text: If we're meeting in 1999, it's the past to me.

g.title: j2523692773
g.text: I guess, personally speaking, it's in both our futures.

g.title: j2893240986
g.text: Only an Entrati could ever make sense of this.

g.title: j3742469605
g.text: but for u personally, it'd still be in ur future, right?

g.title: j62525019
g.text: even though ur coming to the past?

g.title: j2746615071
g.text: Yeah, we'll drive ourselves crazy trying to make sense of time travel.

g.title: j165643057
g.text: Let's just say going to the past is in my future.

g.title: j3444361956
g.text: We can just focus on our cafe date instead.

g.title: j3480136928
g.text: just like a certain doktor I know ^_^

g.title: j2421866400
g.text: It's best if we just focus on our cafe date.

g.title: j1382016547
g.text: ... tell me u aren't about to stand up for the doktor of my comic book nightmares

g.title: j1182075217
g.text: I'll just look forward to our cafe date

g.title: j1230819009
g.text: past, present, future. whenever that trendy cafe finds us, our date there will be awesome <3

g.title: j2813219415
g.text: u'd think i'd be better at spotting sarcasm
